## Sporting Kansas City vs Real Salt Lake Prediction

Two of the most out-of-sorts sides in MLS will square off here, seeking a much-needed victory. Sporting Kansas City have conceded three goals or more in three of their last four games and have not kept a clean sheet in front of their fans for exactly a year.

Real Salt Lake have been dominant in this fixture in recent years but their form in recent weeks is not encouraging.
